name: business-record
description: Inventory, sales, and profit records — one service serves the UI and the API

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix frontend
scripts.build: npm run install:all && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.migrate: node -e "console.log('This server uses Railway Postgres. Set DATABASE_URL. The sqlite scripts under backend/scripts are one-time importers and are not how the server starts.')"
